mechanics.claim: The charge-up applies persistent area damage every 0.25s to nearby enemies, and the detonation deals a separate instance of area damage.
mechanics.quote: The charge up applies {{tip|persistent area damage}} and the detonation deals {{tip|area damage}}.

mechanics.claim: Spell Shield only blocks the recast detonation damage, not the charge-up ticks.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the detonation.

mechanics.claim: The recast automatically triggers at the end of the charge-up duration if not cast manually first.
mechanics.quote: does so automatically after the duration

mechanics.claim: Casting W or its recast while Infected Bonesaw's cast time is active buffers the input to fire at the end of that cast time, delaying it.
mechanics.quote: ''Heart Zapper'' and its recast will buffer and cast at the end of {{ais|Infected Bonesaw|Dr. Mundo}} cast time if attempted to cast during it.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins after the ability's effect (the recast/detonation) completes, not on initial cast.
